name: Rizuhble's Protect The King
rows: Sell it once you're out of slots.
Only if your team has gun heroes.
Cooldown halves when you cast it on a teammate.
Get after Healing Nova if needed. Ahead? Skip it until you're dying. Sell Enchanter's Emblem for it.
One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.
A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.
They hit you with Knockdown, Slowing Hex or Toxic Bullets.
Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.
Their team chains stuns and silences on you.
Instead of Heroic Aura when your team has no gun heroes.
Your Nova and Rite give the teammate you heal its fire rate too. Upgrade of Healing Booster.
changes: Round 13: new support build (the round 12 default is AoE damage) — sources: Kieran's earlier in-game heal support (a6/m/solomon: Heroic Aura, Guardian Ward → Divine Barrier, Enchanter's, Warp Stone, Refresher, same lane opener), seemeta Solomon highest-WR order (57.9%, 354 matches) 1122314422144333 which maxes Kingside Knight by point 10 (T2 +80 barrier and stamina, T3 two allies). Rescue Beam dropped: Kingside Knight already moves a mate (13m, invulnerable while moving), so its pull does nothing extra; Healing Nova (same Healing Rite parent, AoE 325 heal) heals the team instead. Trophy Collector for the support role. Compress Cooldown goes on the knight (25s, cast every fight) instead of the queen. Every item is from Kieran's support build or a kit swap (Healing Nova for Rescue Beam); Mystic Burst → Tankbuster as in his build (bishop impact 70 + 2.0x clears 80/165 at buy). No hero-wide pick rates used.

Round 14: Heroic Aura gets Kieran's condition (only with gun heroes on your team). Echo Shard now sells Trophy Collector (dead-end T2 needed a named sell; Heroic Aura is a support core item). Counters notes made concrete and true (Dispel Magic doesn't stop piece placement; named heroes).

Round 15: Divine Barrier empty note was filled by the default 'Expensive late upgrade...' text: now a real tip. Counters description was 123 chars: now after Healing Nova (the 4.8k health spike), 'Sell Enchanter's Emblem.' Extra Regen note no longer repeats the box title.

Round 17: the damage line is gone so it no longer shares the AoE build's core (Mystic Burst → Tankbuster bought fresh at 20k, Mystic Expansion → Greater Expansion on the bishop). In their place: Healing Booster right after Healing Nova (+20% to your Nova, Rite and Divine Barrier heals; Healing Tempo is its Slot locked upgrade, as on support Dynamo) and Cursed Relic late (a 3.25s silence/disarm on their carry while your team kills it). Heroic Aura note now 'Only if your team has gun heroes.' and a 'Swap for Heroic Aura' box (Knockdown, same 3.2k) keeps the core whole without it. Spikes: spirit 4.8k at 8.8k, health 4.8k at 11.2k unchanged; Cursed Relic leads Late (26.4k) for the next spirit step; core 48k, 12 slots.
Round 20: Refresher moved from core to last in the late list (luxury); Opening Rounds now stays until then. Late list Echo Shard, Witchmail, Cheat Death, Refresher; core+late 75.2k.

Round 23: Healing Tempo moved from Slot locked to the top of the late list. It triggers on any heal you apply to an ally (Healing Nova 18m, Healing Rite), giving them +35% fire rate and move speed for 7s, so it is a real support item here, not a tiny upgrade.
Round 25: ability order 1122314422144333 -> 1122324432413431 (worked out from the kit for this build's playstyle).
Slot locked: Healing Tempo moved out of the rich box (Kieran rule: tiny-gain expensive upgrades are Slot locked).
